name: Monday Work Management
description: Monday Work Management is monday.com's product for coordinating projects and tasks through shared workspaces, boards, groups, items, columns, updates, dashboards, automations, and portfolio views on the monday platform.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Monday Work Management connection or install. Connect the canonical Monday.com provider once, then use its bounded board, item, and update tools under the existing Safe or Dangerously skip permissions policy. Relay does not expose portfolio, dashboard, automation, dependency, resource, goal, template, workspace-administration, or raw GraphQL operations through this alias.

blocked.label: Create a separate Work Management connection
blocked.description: Work Management uses the same monday user, account, OAuth grant, scopes, workspaces, boards, items, and updates as the canonical Monday.com provider; a second connection would duplicate identity and authority.

blocked.label: Install duplicate Work Management tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported monday board, item, and update operations once through the canonical Monday.com provider rather than publishing parallel product tools, policies, and audit state.

blocked.label: Run separate Work Management actions
blocked.description: Supported bounded board and item operations belong to the selected canonical Monday.com connection and its existing Safe or Dangerously skip permissions profile.

blocked.label: Operate extended Work Management features
blocked.description: Portfolio, project, goal, dependency, workload, resource, dashboard, automation, form, template, document, file, import, export, notification, and broad-search workflows are outside Relay's current typed monday connector.

blocked.label: Administer monday or use raw interfaces
blocked.description: Workspace, board, group, column, user, team, permission, plan, billing, and app administration, destructive or bulk changes, webhooks, raw GraphQL, platform MCP, browser sessions, scraping, and private endpoints are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Monday.com
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Work Management action is enabled because the product shares the canonical Monday.com provider and its bounded board, item, and update boundary.

runtimeSupport.description: No duplicate Monday Work Management tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical Monday.com provider for approved bounded board, item, and update workflows.
No duplicate Monday Work Management tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical Monday.com provider for approved bounded board, item, and update workflows.

providerSetup.blocker: Monday Work Management is a monday.com product on the shared monday platform, not a separate provider identity or authorization surface. Monday documents that its platform GraphQL API supports Work Management and operates on account-scoped workspaces, boards, items, column values, and updates under the same user and app permissions. Relay's canonical Monday.com provider already owns the OAuth lifecycle, account binding, typed connector, policies, runtime mounts, audit, and bounded board and item behavior. A second provider card would duplicate that authority and could imply unsupported access to broader Work Management features.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this product-mode slug non-installable and direct setup, connection, installation, and supported execution to the canonical Monday.com provider. Use only its explicit bounded board listing, board-item listing, item read, update read, local draft, approval-governed item create or update, and update-posting actions. Extend the canonical provider only after Relay separately specifies, implements, and accepts any additional Work Management resource with exact scope, account and workspace binding, bounds, approvals, idempotency, audit, redaction, provider limits, and production verification.

evidence.supports: Monday presents monday work management as its projects-and-tasks product alongside monday CRM and monday dev on one monday platform.

Monday states that the shared GraphQL platform API supports monday work management, dev, sales CRM, and service and operates on account resources including workspaces, boards, items, and column values.
Monday documents one app OAuth authorization against a selected monday account with granular account, workspace, board, and update scopes rather than separate product credentials.
Monday documents boards as the shared API containers for groups, columns, items, workspaces, and related work data.
Monday documents items as core board objects and publishes scoped read and write operations through the same platform API.
